_comment: Tushar Chopra (RMA, MARN 2418420 -- see pfec-presenters / 2026-08-19 reel) on the 189 invitation round, Thu 15 Oct 2026 (verified Thursday). Fast-paced jump-cut edit: content segments open at 0.00 / 0.99 / 2.48 / 5.14 / 7.68 / 9.54, end 11.59. caption_txt.title: 189 Invitation Round This Thursday, 15 October! 🚨🚨
body: The long-awaited 189 (Skilled Independent) invitation round is happening this Thursday, 15 October. If you've lodged your Expression of Interest (EOI), this is the round you've been waiting for.

Good luck to everyone who has lodged their EOI! If you need any assistance with your EOI or your next steps, our Registered Migration Agent Tushar Chopra (MARN 2418420) and the PFEC team are here to help.
